## Hawaii Packing List

### Clothing
- Lightweight swimsuits
- Quick-dry shorts/running shorts
- Light long-sleeve shirts or rash guards
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops for beach
- Light jacket or hoodie (for cooler evenings)
- Towels

### Toiletries
- Sunscreen
- Beach towel
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (if provided)
- Beach hat or sunglasses
